Guggenheim Capital Llc increased its stake in Rexnord Corp New (RXN) by 16.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guggenheim Capital Llc bought 65,609 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 460,640 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.67 million, up from 395,031 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guggenheim Capital Llc who had been investing in Rexnord Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.15B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.05% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $30.23. About 443,072 shares traded. Rexnord Corporation (NYSE:RXN) has risen 25.91% since June 8, 2017 and is uptrending.
